newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICAN SUPERSPORT SERIES SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICAN SUPERSPORT SERIES SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores in the Supersport series cricket matches on Monday:
In Durban (day three): Natal beat Griqualand West by an innings and 156 runs. Griqualand West 91 and 166 (Derek Crookes 5-43), Natal 413-3 declared.
In Bloemfontein (day three): Free State 401 and 226-3 (Deon Jordaan 103 not out), Border 367-9 declared (Piet Botha 136, Peter Kirsten 56, Mark Boucher 53, Herman Bakkes 6-43).
In Paarl (day two): Boland 204 and 2-0, Eastern Province 262 (Mark Rushmere 89 not out, Grant Morgan 64).
